title: Naturality of normalized ordinary tensor models on K-flat inputs
statement: For a normalized one-K-flat ordinary tensor model, the comparison is natural when both second inputs are K-flat.

source.place: Native tensor transport, geometric tensor part of step 1; normalization determines naturality.

proof.text: Use the existing NativeCurrying.internalHomEquiv and uncurry_component calculation. For an actual chain map a:ordinaryTensorTotal(P,Q) to a K-injective I, apply normalization to its curry. The coproduct inclusions in each total degree show that the normalized witness is a itself. Thus model.hom;Q(a) is the inverse closed transpose of Q(curry(a));R.model.inv.

The counit formula for inverse transposition and S.evaluation_naturality give its naturality in both tensor inputs. Apply chain-level currying naturality to mapBifunctorMap(f,g);a. The supplied R.naturality, conjugated by its model isomorphisms, identifies the two derived Hom arrows, so the two proposed tensor composites become equal after postcomposition with Q(a).

Choose a monomorphic quasi-isomorphism a from ordinaryTensorTotal(P',Q') to a K-injective I. Its image Q(a) is an isomorphism, so cancel it from the equality of the preceding step. This proves the original naturality square without replacing or changing model and without an additional unproved statement.

proof_origin.place: Naturality of evaluation and transposition; implemented using the existing native degree-zero currying calculation and a K-injective target resolution.

theorem native_ordinary_tensor_model_naturality_kflat
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (H : (DerivedCategory (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y))ᵒᵖ ×
      DerivedCategory (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y))
    (R : NativeHomRepresentatives (ordinaryIhomBifunctor l Y) H)
    (S : CoefficientClosedStructure H)
    (model : ∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y) ℤ)
      (_ : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y P),
      S.tensor.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q, DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj (ordinaryTensorTotal l Y P Q))
    (_hnormalization : NativeAdjunctionNormalization
      (ordinaryIhomBifunctor l Y) (ordinaryTensorBifunctor l Y)
      (fun P ↦ Mod.ihomAdjunction P) H R S
      (NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y) model) :
    ∀ (P Q P' Q' : CochainComplex (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y) ℤ)
      (hP : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y P)
      (hP' : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y P')
      (hQ : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y Q)
      (hQ' : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y Q')
      (f : P ⟶ P') (g : Q ⟶ Q'),
      S.tensor.map
          (X := (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q, DerivedCategory.Q.obj P))
          (Y := (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q', DerivedCategory.Q.obj P'))
          (Prod.mkHom (DerivedCategory.Q.map g) (DerivedCategory.Q.map f)) ≫
          (model P' Q' hP').hom =
        (model P Q hP).hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map
          (HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap f g
            (ordinaryTensorBifunctor l Y) (.up ℤ))
